= Fallen from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Sigil of Power''' is a [[spell]] which places a sigil in an [[area of effect|area]] around the caster for a [[duration]]. The sigil grants added [[lightning]] damage to the caster and their allies. Spending mana while within the sigil empowers it, increasing the buff effect and when full powered, causes enemies within the sigil to deal less damage. ==Skill functions and interactions== Mana must be spent to gain stages, typically by paying [[cost]]s or through effects that specifically ''spend'' mana such as [[Arcane Cloak]]. Paying mana costs with non-mana resources (e.g. {{psl|Eldritch Battery}}) does not contribute to stage gain. Each skill usage within the area can only increase the number of stages by one, regardless of Mana spent. Sigil of Power can advance to stage 2 immediately, as being placed at stage 1 doesn't count as "gaining" a stage. Advancing to stage 3 or higher takes a minimum of one second after the previous stage was gained. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Mana
